no_bid_reason: M005: Visakoivu Oy does not hold a valid NMSB 73710 information security certificate, required under clause 3.5 of this invitation because the site includes remote management of the building automation system. All other eligibility requirements (3.1-3.4) are met, but this single certification gap makes Visakoivu ineligible under the tender's own terms; Visakoivu is declining to bid on this basis rather than submit a quotation it cannot honour.
